source: 2021/TSB Vol. 21 No. 02 - MAP Sensor adapters for EDR-3.pdf
title: MAP Sensor Adapters For Induction Services
lead: MOC has created two new adapters that make induction services easier with the EDR-3 machine through the MAP sensor port, keeping the MAP sensor connected to the vehicle during the service. This may help hold the engine at the recommended RPM.
body: These adapters can only be used with the EDR-3 machines.
